records.name: Phi Gamma Nu (PGN) Professional Business Fraternity
records.summary: A Penn business fraternity for students who want career skills and a chance to do community service. It hosts business-field events and outreach projects, and it recruits new members in rounds.
records.what_you_do: Go to business-field events, help with community outreach, and take part in chapter life with other students who are interested in business.

first_step.how: Check pgnupenn.org/recruitment for the next round, then fill out the interest form and sign up for a coffee chat. The spring 2026 round was open to first-years and sophomores.
first_step.basis: Joining starts with an interest form and a coffee chat, and the site does not explain how members are chosen.

records.notes: Newest dated item is the 'Spring 2026 Recruitment' call. No month is printed, so no last_sign_of_life month is recorded. The directory flags the club INACTIVE and says it is not accepting members, but the club's own site shows a spring 2026 recruitment round, which outweighs that flag. The directory's application field is an unlabeled number. The site does not say whether an interview or application is required. The next recruitment date is not posted.

records.name: Policy Consulting Group at Penn (PPC)
records.summary: A nonpartisan Penn student group that writes policy research and recommendations for outside partners. It recruits new associate consultants each fall.
records.what_you_do: Associate consultants research policy questions at several levels of government and help write the recommendations. Past partners have included international organizations and companies.

first_step.how: The fall 2026 application has closed. Sign up for the club's listserv or email the club to hear about the next round.
first_step.basis: Members are recruited by application each fall, and the fall 2026 application has already closed.

records.notes: The directory flags the club INACTIVE, but the club's own directory entry says it is welcoming new members in fall 2026, and that dated statement outweighs the flag. The club website shows only a 2026 copyright footer, which is not evidence, and does not repeat the fall 2026 text. The application close date is printed as a Tuesday in September with no year, so no month is recorded. The directory marks the club as not accepting members for now.

records.name: South Asia Society
records.summary: A Penn student group that shares South Asian culture with the wider campus. It runs a membership for each school year, group chats for new students, and social events such as a cultural show and a formal.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for membership for the school year, join the chat for your class or the dance group, and come to shows, socials, and the semi-formal.

first_step.how: Sign up through the club's membership form for the 2026 to 2027 school year, or join the group chat for the class of 2030. Both links are on the club's link page.
first_step.basis: The link page has a group chat for the class of 2030 and a freshman dance chat, and the directory says the club helps incoming students settle in.

records.notes: The directory flags the club INACTIVE, but the club's link page lists a membership form for 2026 to 2027, 2026 semi-formal photos and waitlist, and a 2026 board election meeting (the date is printed as 12/9 with no year next to it). No month is printed for the 2026 items, so no last_sign_of_life month is recorded. The link page also lists photo galleries and an alumni database, which were not opened. No forms were submitted.

records.name: SPEC Connaissance
records.summary: A Penn student committee that books well-known speakers for campus talks. Members help pick the speakers, get into events free, and can meet the speaker afterward.
records.what_you_do: Come to the Tuesday general body meetings to help choose speakers, attend the talks at no cost, and join the backstage meet-and-greet.

schedule.text: General body meetings on Tuesdays, 9 to 10 pm, in Huntsman Hall

cost.text: General body members get free access to events

first_step.how: Come to a Tuesday general body meeting. The club's site says no application is needed. You can also join the listserv or GroupMe for updates.
first_step.basis: Meetings are open to any interested student, and the site says no application is needed.

records.notes: The directory flags the club INACTIVE. The club's site lists speaker seasons up to 2025 to 2026, with no month printed. That season overlaps the last 12 months, so the club is marked active at medium confidence and no last_sign_of_life month is recorded. The directory's application field conflicts with the site, which says no application is needed for general body meetings. The site also says Penn students can join the listserv.

notes: Ran 0 WebSearch calls and 37 WebFetch calls: 20 directory entries, 13 club sites or link pages, and 4 retries. Four records are full records with dated 2026 evidence (status active): Phi Gamma Nu (spring 2026 recruitment), Policy Consulting Group (fall 2026 recruiting in its directory entry), South Asia Society (2026 to 2027 membership and 2026 items on its link page), and SPEC Connaissance (2025 to 2026 speaker season, medium confidence). Sixteen are held back with status unknown and no summary. Reasons: no club website at all (Poker at Penn, Polish Club, Quadramics, QuakerBots, Quakers Venture Club, South Asian Women's Space, SPEC Sound); a site with no dated items (Sound Politicks, Sparks Dance Company, SPEC Film Society, SPEC Jazz & Grooves, PRISM, whose only year is a 2017 footer); a site dated only 2024 and 2025 (Quackers Bird Club); a site that would not load (Philomathean); and two dead pages (SPEC Pop Up and SPEC-TRUM, both 404 on specevents.net). Most directory statuses are INACTIVE with approved and active flags that conflict with it; PRISM and QuakerBots show UNDER REVIEW. Individual contact emails that look like a student's or a staff member's personal address were left out. Instagram, Facebook and Google Forms were not opened for facts. No student names were recorded.
